create_checkpoint_status_enum: create a CheckpointStatus enum with STARTED, COMPLETED, and FAILED values for tracking pipeline stages
write_checkpoint_method: write a checkpoint with run_id, instance_id, name, status, and optional data to the logging service
use_write_checkpoint_cm_context_manager: use the write_checkpoint_cm context manager to automatically log STARTED, COMPLETED, or FAILED status with runtime
implement_write_checkpoint_impl_subclass: implement the abstract _write_checkpoint_impl method in a subclass of TraceLoggingService to define custom checkpoint storage
extract_caller_and_error_info: extract caller file location and current exception details into a dictionary for checkpoint metadata
